title: coord.py dedup sees another agent's claim on the same area: the holder is the agent's own, the topic is the article it writes, and a question with no lack term still claims its topic
goal: with no --holder, coord.py takes the holder from KB_COORD_HOLDER; coord.py dedup treats a live claim under its own holder name as its own only when --token names that claim's token, so a second session that picked the same name sees the claim as an overlap; dedup --topic PATH anchors the claim on PATH instead of the pack's first article, and a question whose pack names no lack term claims the topic as a whole, which overlaps every later dedup on that topic; and step 0 of /kb-research passes --topic with the article path it will write and leaves --holder to KB_COORD_HOLDER when that is set

gates.question: How does coord.py dedup tell its own earlier claim from another session's claim under the same holder name (today: by name alone, so two agents that both picked kb-research-pip each research the same terms)?
options: own only with proof: a same-name claim is an overlap unless the call passes the lease key its earlier dedup printed
refuse a holder name another live claim already uses
keep by name and rely on KB_COORD_HOLDER being unique

notes: Premise runs 2026-10-19 on origin/main 7079b184a. (1) Transcripts of the SP-3pvz2noj research runs (~/.claude/projects/*bench-multi-*): every kb-arm research agent did run coord.py dedup from /kb-research step 0 with KB_COORD_STORE set, but picked its own --holder text: in sandbox 858a5dbd agents 1 and 2 both used kb-research-pip, so agent 1's dedup counted agent 2's four claims as its own (claimed [], uncovered all four, overlaps []) and researched them again. Reproduced on a planted store: a second dedup under the same holder name gets claimed [] and uncovered all terms, a third holder gets the overlap. (2) coord.fingerprint on four wordings of the same pip area: topics public/gitlab/package-registries and public/privacy/spacy-pipeline-pinning, lack terms 0, 3, 0 and 4; in most runs agents 1 and 2 got terms [] and claimed nothing. Checks 1-3 fail on main (holder anonymous; same-name dedup claims nothing and sees no overlap; --topic unknown, exit 2); check 4 fails (step 0 names neither --topic nor KB_COORD_HOLDER).
